title: Hearty Nutty French Prawns Mille Feuille
description: A multilayered French-inspired dish of tiger prawns and toasted nuts, braised gently in a tandoor clay pot and finished with a bright lemon‑egg binder.
instructions: Preheat a tandoor clay pot over low heat until it is hot but not smoking.
Toast the almonds and hazelnuts in a dry skillet until golden and fragrant, then set aside.
Sauté the minced shallot and garlic in olive oil and butter until translucent.
Add the tiger prawns to the skillet, stirring until they just start to turn pink.
Deglaze the pan with white wine, scraping up any browned bits, and let it reduce for two minutes.
Simmer the prawns until they are fully cooked, about three minutes, then remove from heat.
Arrange a thin layer of prawns in the bottom of the tandoor pot, sprinkle a layer of toasted nuts over them, and repeat until the pot is filled.
Sprinkle the chopped herbs and lemon zest over the layers, then pour the beaten egg evenly on top to bind the layers together.
Return the pot to the tandoor and warm through for five minutes, watching that the egg sets but does not overcook.
Serve the mille feuille hot, spooning any residual sauce over the top.
